ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart Synthetic CCD — True-date frame: synthetic events are moved into the patient's historical lifetime. Codes, instruments, and treatments remain modern and are anachronistic.

text.paragraph: New patient visit for swelling of the face and legs and dark urine after a sore throat: urgent kidney and streptococcal tests, treatment of fluid overload and the infection, and an urgent nephrology referral. Concerns: He is afraid his kidneys will be damaged for good; He loses income for every concert and lesson he misses. [S]

Furosemide 40 mg tablet, one tablet by mouth each morning while swollen

Health insurance through a performing artists' plan; worried about missing concerts and lessons, which he is paid for only when he plays or teaches [S]

tr.td: New patient visit for swelling of the face and legs and dark urine after a sore throat: urgent kidney and streptococcal tests, treatment of fluid overload and the infection, and an urgent nephrology referral
Two-day follow-up and nephrology consultation with ECG and echocardiogram
Two-week review: fluid, blood pressure, kidney function and C3; stop the diuretic
Six-week review: C3, kidney function, urine protein and blood, and the long-term plan
Same-day sick visit for a cold

code.displayName: Periodic reevaluation and management of healthy individual

tr.td: Urgent nephrology consultation within days for an acute nephritic syndrome with hypertension and a rise in creatinine: confirm the cause, decide whether a kidney biopsy is needed, and advise on fluid and blood pressure

Sodium below 2 g a day, fluids limited to about 1.5 liters a day while swollen, and daily morning weights, with a call if weight rises 1 kg in a day, urine output falls, or headache, vision change, or breathlessness appear
Furosemide each morning for edema and hypertension until he is back to his usual weight with normal blood pressure, with potassium and creatinine checked at each visit
Penicillin V for ten days to eradicate group A streptococcus
Stop ibuprofen and avoid all NSAIDs while the kidneys recover; acetaminophen for pain
Assessment for acute rheumatic fever against the 1773 revised Jones criteria, with an ECG and an echocardiogram at the consultation; secondary prophylaxis only if the criteria are met

Monitoring until recovery: creatinine and potassium at each visit, C3 at two and six to eight weeks, urinalysis and urine protein-to-creatinine ratio at six weeks, six months, and a year, and blood pressure every year after; a kidney biopsy only if C3 stays low beyond eight weeks, creatinine keeps rising, nephrotic-range proteinuria persists, or the course is otherwise atypical
Swelling gone and back to his usual weight of about 61 kg within two weeks
61.2 kg with no edema at two weeks
Blood pressure below 130/80 mmHg with no blood pressure medicine needed by six weeks
116/74 off all medicines at six weeks; the diuretic was stopped at two weeks
Creatinine back to normal by six weeks
0.92 mg/dL at six weeks, from a peak of 1.78
C3 back to normal within eight weeks
Not yet met: 180 mg/g at six weeks, from 1400; recheck at six months
